PERF-001.note: 60 samples per cell, sequential and at 10 concurrent clients, 4-CPU container: every API read p95 ≤ 25 ms sequential / ≤ 176 ms at c10; every page p95 ≤ 33 ms sequential / ≤ 363 ms at c10 — inside the repository's alerting thresholds (p95 > 1 s, p99 > 2 s, docs/observability.md). Local measurement, not a production capacity claim.

PERF-DISC-001.note: notification.email drains at exactly 30 jobs/min per worker process (pg-boss work() with default batchSize 1 and 2 s polling, platform/jobs/queue.ts). Under the campaign's bursts the median queue wait was 1,054 s (p95 1,281 s). Admin notifications fan out to every permitted Admin Member, multiplying volume. The Sales email code is sent synchronously and is unaffected; no email is lost. P3 capacity ceiling.

DATA-DISC-003.note: prisma/seed/dev-sales.ts writes four assisted dealerships directly, none with an OWNER membership — one of them ACTIVE (Kaveri Auto Hub) — contradicting the #301 invariant that an assisted dealership has its owner from creation (proved for the API path by sales-assisted-onboarding.test.ts). Development seed only (dev-guard refuses production). P3.

DOC-DISC-002.note: CLAUDE.md §4 invariant 6 says a sold car stays on the marketplace (greyed, badged, sorted last). The implemented policy (R71, #194) removes SOLD and WITHDRAWN cars from every public surface, and the harness confirms it (PUBLIC-011, SEARCH-002). The operating manual contradicts the product. P3 documentation defect.

UAT-OBS-001.note: A signed-out visitor on /saved (e.g. right after Logout in that tab) sees “No saved cars yet — Tap the heart…”, which reads as if their saved cars were lost, instead of a prompt to sign in to see them. The data is intact (signing in shows them). P3 UX.

UAT-OBS-002.note: Cosmetic: an unknown car URL renders <title> “Car not found” but the heading “Page not found / 404” (and HTTP 200, BUG-101); the footer prints the support number unformatted (+91••••••8890). P3.

SEC-DISC-002.note: Bounded urlencoded-body abuse against the API (1 MB of a[]=, deep nesting, 100k indexed keys, a 400k-item comma list): each refused in 4–16 ms (400/401); /health/live ok throughout.

RECOVERY-DISC-001.note: Unplanned: the session's container worker restarted mid-campaign, stopping PostgreSQL and every API and web process with 461 notification jobs queued. After restart all services came back healthy, the queued jobs resumed draining at the same 30/min (EVIDENCE/email-queue), and the final full regression pass — every campaign including the DATA-* integrity checks in c09 — ran afterwards against the same database.

UAT-OBS-003.note: The dealer console shows “0 credits” in its top bar and a “Listing credits 0” panel in the sidebar, although billing is deferred (F050–F054) and there is no way to buy or use credits. A dealer may read it as a blocker. P3 UX / product decision.
